---
title: "Cheat sheets"
subtitle: "Every week's key equations on one page"
jupyter: python3
execute:
  echo: false
  freeze: false     # rebuilt on every render, so it never lags the week pages
---

```{python}
#| output: asis
from pathlib import Path

from rlc.page import cheat_sheet, page_title

for page in sorted(Path("weeks").glob("w*.qmd")):
    href = f"weeks/{page.name}"
    print(f"\n## [{page_title(page)}]({href})\n")
    print(cheat_sheet(page, href) or "*No cheat sheet yet.*")
    print()
```
